transcript_screening.interpretation: Dictionary retrieval and a single-analyst semantic audit. Not prevalence, causal evidence, OPC evidence, or inter-coder reliability.

tabular_reanalysis.interpretation: Descriptive configurational stress test only. Mechanism labels are not a maturity ladder and the 18 basins are not OPCs.
